propositions: The close precheck scans all reachable commit messages and calls the shared ticket resolver for every extracted reference, causing unrelated ambiguous-prefix diagnostics to print to stderr.
The resolver writes ambiguity errors even when precheck only needs to know whether a reference matches accepted target IDs, producing diagnostic noise that does not affect gate semantics.

Passing quiet=True to resolve_ticket_id only during history-scan candidates in _referencing_commit_exists suppresses unrelated ambiguity diagnostics while preserving them for explicit user-supplied ambiguous prefixes.
The fix maintains correct gate behavior: valid full-ID references are still detected when earlier history contains an ambiguous short prefix.
